title: [YSQL] Index aggregate pushdown double-counts
body:
Jira Link: [DB-7464](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-7464)
### Description

Could get wrong results with index only aggregate pushdown on range partitioned index that is split.  If the query asks for values on partition != first, double the requests can be sent.

```sql
create table split (i int, primary key (i asc)) split at values ((2));
insert into split values (1), (2), (3);
explain select count(*) from split where i = 2;
```

```
                                  QUERY PLAN                                  
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Finalize Aggregate  (cost=4.12..4.12 rows=1 width=8)
   ->  Index Scan using split_pkey on split  (cost=0.00..4.11 rows=1 width=0)
         Index Cond: (i = 2)
         Partial Aggregate: true
(4 rows)
```

```sql
select count(*) from split where i = 1; -- 1
select count(*) from split where i = 2; -- 2
select count(*) from split where i = 3; -- 2
```

```sql
create index on split (i asc) split at values ((3));
explain /*+IndexOnlyScan(split split_i_idx)*/ select count(*) from split where i = 3;
```

```
                                     QUERY PLAN                                      
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Finalize Aggregate  (cost=5.15..5.16 rows=1 width=8)
   ->  Index Only Scan using split_i_idx on split  (cost=0.00..5.12 rows=10 width=0)
         Index Cond: (i = 3)
         Partial Aggregate: true
(4 rows)
```

```sql
/*+IndexOnlyScan(split split_i_idx)*/ select count(*) from split where i = 1; -- 1
/*+IndexOnlyScan(split split_i_idx)*/ select count(*) from split where i = 2; -- 1
/*+IndexOnlyScan(split split_i_idx)*/ select count(*) from split where i = 3; -- 2
```

Comparing the docdb requests (`SET yb_debug_log_docdb_requests TO on`), `count(*)` target for `i = 3` indexonlyscan gives

```
I0801 16:55:50.600991 3377263 pg_session.cc:305] Applying operation: { READ active: 1 read_time: { read: <invalid> local_limit: <invalid> global_limit: <invalid> in_txn_limit: <invalid> serial_no: 0 } request: client: YQL_CLIENT_PGSQL stmt_id: 4658963652864 schema_version: 0 targets { tscall { opcode: 4 operands { value { int64_value: 0 } } } } column_refs { } is_forward_scan: 1 is_aggregate: 1 limit: 1024 return_paging_state: 1 ysql_catalog_version: 27 range_column_values { value { int32_value: 3 } } table_id: "000033f500003000800000000000405b" upper_bound { key: "48800000037E7E21" is_inclusive: 1 } partition_key: "48800000030021" size_limit: 0 }
I0801 16:55:50.601063 3377263 pg_session.cc:305] Applying operation: { READ active: 1 read_time: { read: <invalid> local_limit: <invalid> global_limit: <invalid> in_txn_limit: <invalid> serial_no: 0 } request: client: YQL_CLIENT_PGSQL stmt_id: 4658963652864 schema_version: 0 targets { tscall { opcode: 4 operands { value { int64_value: 0 } } } } column_refs { } is_forward_scan: 1 is_aggregate: 1 limit: 1024 return_paging_state: 1 ysql_catalog_version: 27 range_column_values { value { int32_value: 3 } } table_id: "000033f500003000800000000000405b" lower_bound { key: "48800000030021" is_inclusive: 1 } partition_key: "48800000030021" size_limit: 0 }
I0801 16:55:50.601084 3377263 pg_session.cc:332] Flushing collected operations, using session type: kTransactional num ops: 2
```

whereas `1` target gives

```
I0801 16:55:56.888206 3377263 pg_session.cc:305] Applying operation: { READ active: 1 read_time: { read: <invalid> local_limit: <invalid> global_limit: <invalid> in_txn_limit: <invalid> serial_no: 0 } request: client: YQL_CLIENT_PGSQL stmt_id: 4658963656960 schema_version: 0 targets { column_id: 10 } column_refs { ids: 10 } is_forward_scan: 1 is_aggregate: 0 limit: 1024 return_paging_state: 1 ysql_catalog_version: 27 range_column_values { value { int32_value: 3 } } table_id: "000033f500003000800000000000405b" upper_bound { key: "48800000037E7E21" is_inclusive: 1 } col_refs { column_id: 10 attno: 1 } partition_key: "48800000030021" size_limit: 0 }
I0801 16:55:56.888273 3377263 pg_session.cc:332] Flushing collected operations, using session type: kTransactional num ops: 1
```

Notice the additional request with `lower_bound { key: "48800000030021" is_inclusive: 1 }` for the same partition in the aggregate case.

Tested around master commit fd6b58df205f8fd659cd66a8ce7f69dff5c96cfb, alma8, fastdebug, gcc11.
